listen_address.description: Network interface IP to bind the web server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port the web server listens on.

base_url.description: Optional URL prefix for deployment behind a reverse proxy (e.g., '/files' when proxied at https://example.com/files). Leave empty for root deployment.

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS encryption. If true, SSL certificate and key paths must be configured.

ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required when https_enabled is true.

ssl_key.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required when https_enabled is true.

max_upload_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed size (in megabytes) for each uploaded file.

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on CPU cores (recommended for production).

upload_temp_dir.description: Directory used for temporary file storage during uploads. Ensure it exists and is writable by the service user.

storage.description: Configuration for persistent file storage backend.

local.description: Local filesystem storage settings (used when type = local).

path.description: Absolute path to the directory where uploaded files are stored.

s3.description: Amazon S3-compatible storage settings (used when type = s3).

bucket.description: S3 bucket name for file storage.

region.description: AWS region (e.g., 'us-east-1' or custom endpoint region).

access_key_id.description: S3 access key ID with write permissions to the bucket.

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key for the S3 credentials.

local.description: Local username/password authentication (used when type = local).

allow_registration.description: Whether new users may register themselves (true) or only admins may create accounts (false).

items.description: OAuth2 client ID issued by the provider.

fields.description: User info endpoint URL to fetch profile details.

items.description: List of OAuth2 scopes to request (e.g., ['openid', 'email']).
